item.title: Tecrys Vault 0.1.0 (build 34)
item.description:
• Backups to several destinations: folders, iCloud Drive and Google Drive (the folders their apps sync), each with its own time, days between backups and number of backups kept (midnight, every 3 days, keep 3 to start with).
  • Backups can be encrypted with a password (on for iCloud Drive and Google Drive); without the password nobody can read them.
  • Each backup copies only the files that are new; the kept backups share them, so keeping 3 takes little more space than 1.
  • Restore… picks a destination and a backup by its date.
  • Linux: packages for ordinary PCs (amd64) besides arm64 and 32-bit Raspberry Pi.
  • Test Connection says when the database user may not create the database.

item.title: Tecrys Vault 0.1.0 (build 33)
item.description:
• Linux packages for Raspberry Pi and other ARM computers: arm64 (64-bit Raspberry Pi OS Trixie, Debian 13, Ubuntu 25.04+) and armhf (32-bit Raspberry Pi OS Bookworm and newer).
  • Fixed: on 32-bit computers the server refused every upload and login as too large.
  • Help ▸ Server Computers says which Linux package to download.

item.description: • Help ▸ Suggest a Feature… and Report a Problem… open the forms on github.com/jakpokcz/tecrys-vault-releases, with your version and platform filled in.

item.title: Tecrys Vault 0.1.0 (build 31)
item.description:
• First release of Tecrys Vault: serves a team's vault to Tecrys and Tecrys PDM, with users, backups and settings.
  • The vault's database can be built in, PostgreSQL or MariaDB, and moved between them.
  • A new vault starts with a trial; after it a licence is installed in the app.
